criteria.name: Requested JSON form
criteria.description: Returns compact JSON with target_family, metrics, gates, answer, and computed_consequence.

criteria.name: Numeric anchors and formulas
criteria.description: Computes release volume in MCM, crest excess, flow floor in m3/s, precipitation maximum, radar span, and coverage balance with correct units.

criteria.name: Threshold gates
criteria.description: Applies the release, river, rainfall guardrail, and radar context gates using the stated inequalities and reaches the correct answer label.

criteria.name: Component reasoning
criteria.description: Shows how the conversion, difference, maximum, span, and balance calculations were derived from event-package values rather than listing raw numbers only.

criteria.name: Computed rejection
criteria.description: Rejects rainfall trigger dominance from the below-1 mm precipitation guardrail while the release and river gates pass.

criteria.name: Concise consequence
criteria.description: Keeps the computed consequence short and tied to the gates.

criteria.name: No overreach
criteria.description: Avoids treating radar context, annual surface change, population context, or amenity counts as loss accounting.

decision_rule.summary: All four gates must pass: release volume above 50 MCM, river crest and flow above thresholds, event-window precipitation below 1 mm with missing daily mean, and usable pre/post radar context.

thresholds.rainfall_guardrail: precip_mean_max_mm < 1.0 and daily precipitation mean is missing
thresholds.radar_context_gate: pre_count >= 5 and post_count >= 5 and radar_span_db >= 20 and coverage_balance >= 0.5

provenance.notes: Deterministic local-file calculation with fixed formulas and numeric tolerances.
